description: The bar chart, titled "Accuracy (%)", displays the performance of four different reasoning methods—CoT, CoD, CCoT, and CoUT—measured by their accuracy in percentage. The horizontal axis lists these methods, with CoT represented by a red bar, CoD by an orange bar, CCoT by a light blue bar, and CoUT by a green bar. The vertical axis on the left, labeled "Accuracy (%)", ranges from 70 to 100, with the values of the bars explicitly shown above each bar: CoT is 91.19%, CoD is 80.89%, CCoT is 88.50%, and CoUT is 88.40%. The chart also includes a secondary vertical axis on the right, labeled "Token Count", which ranges from 0 to 800. This axis corresponds to the height of the bars, with the token count values shown above each bar: CoT is 676.85, CoD is 534.24, CCoT is 445.91, and CoUT is 354.46. The data shows that CoT achieves the highest accuracy, while CoUT has the lowest.
